prompt:
Rewrite snippets/bundle-contents-list.liquid so that it lists the contents of a product bundle with exact integer money arithmetic. All amounts are integer cents. Do not use floating-point division. Inputs (all top-level variables, there is no section object): - items: array, never null, may be empty. Each element is an object with: - title: string. - quantity: integer >= 0. - unit_price_cents: integer >= 0. - discount_percent: integer from 0 to 100, or null. Null means 0. Rules: 1. Items with quantity 0 are ignored completely. They produce no row and add nothing to any total. 2. If no item has quantity > 0, including when items is empty, output exactly

This bundle is empty

and nothing else. 3. Otherwise compute the following values: - line = quantity * unit_price_cents for each remaining item. - subtotal = the sum of all lines. - savings = floor(subtotal * discount_percent / 100). Compute this once on the subtotal, not per line, and round down. Do not round to nearest. - total = subtotal - savings. 4. Money format: a value of C cents is written as $ followed by the integer part (C divided by 100, rounded down), a dot, and the remainder (C modulo 100) as exactly two digits with zero padding. For example, 5 is $0.05, 110 is $1.10, 10020 is $100.20 and 0 is $0.00. 5. Output these parts in order, with no whitespace between tags: -
    . - One row per remaining item in input order:
  • QUANTITYTITLELINE
    • . TITLE is HTML-escaped with the escape filter and LINE is money-formatted. -
. -

Subtotal: SUBTOTAL

. - Only when discount_percent is greater than 0 (even if savings comes out to 0):

Savings (P%): -SAVINGS

, where P is the integer discount_percent. -

Total: TOTAL

. All amounts are money-formatted. Example: one item {"title":"Pen","quantity":3,"unit_price_cents":333} with discount_percent 10 gives line $9.99, Savings (10%): -$0.99 and Total: $9.00. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/bundle-contents-list.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
